facts.recommendationText: Run a forecast-accuracy and ABC inventory analysis with a demand-segmentation review Locate the forecast/stock mismatch before any blanket inventory change A forecast-accuracy and ABC inventory analysis is analysis-only and reversible; it avoids an across-the-board inventory cut that would stock out best-sellers. Stock is misallocated against demand; the forecast mismatch must be measured before any inventory move Measure forecast error by SKU/ABC class and quantify stockouts vs overstock. Forecast error and stock misallocation quantified by SKU class Segment demand variability to right-size stock by velocity — protecting best-sellers, trimming slow lines. Velocity-segmented stock plan drafted protecting best-sellers
